# Non-test Go files that name a host-only tool (launchctl, cmux, osascript, diskutil)
# in a string literal (gt-v3sdr2).
#
# Each line is: path<TAB>tool<TAB>class<TAB>reason
#   class   pending-deletion, the only class: the reason names the gt-in-container
#           deletion area that removes the use.
#
# The list is a ratchet. TestRepoHostTools fails on a host-tool literal this file does
# not list, and on a line whose file no longer names its tool: delete that line in the
# deletion that removes the use. Do not add a line for new code; remove the use instead.
internal/bird/spawn.go	cmux	pending-deletion	bird spawner: opens the bird's cmux tab, deleted with the bird spawner
internal/cmd/bird.go	cmux	pending-deletion	bird spawner: the bird command help names cmux, deleted with the bird spawner
internal/cmd/daemon.go	launchctl	pending-deletion	remaining launchd references: the restart help says the restart reloads the program through launchctl kickstart
internal/cmd/daemon_cutover.go	launchctl	pending-deletion	remaining launchd references: the cutover diagnosis names the launchd job it stops
internal/cmd/daemon_supervisor.go	launchctl	pending-deletion	remaining launchd references: the launchd supervisor start, stop and bootstrap commands
internal/cmd/host_agent.go	launchctl	pending-deletion	host agent and probes: the host agent install prints the launchctl bootstrap command for the operator
internal/config/daemon_steps.go	launchctl	pending-deletion	remaining launchd references: the cloud-check step description names launchctl
internal/daemon/upgrade_heal.go	launchctl	pending-deletion	remaining launchd references: the upgrade heal script bootouts and bootstraps the launchd job
internal/doctor/daemon_job_check.go	launchctl	pending-deletion	remaining launchd references: the job check fix hint tells the operator to run launchctl print
internal/doctor/daemon_respawn_check.go	launchctl	pending-deletion	remaining launchd references: the respawn check fix hint tells the operator to run launchctl print
internal/doctor/openshell_gateway_check.go	launchctl	pending-deletion	host agent and probes: the gateway probe runs launchctl print and its fix hint kickstarts the agent
internal/installer/gateway.go	launchctl	pending-deletion	installer: the gateway install bootstraps its launchd job, deleted with the installer
internal/power/power.go	launchctl	pending-deletion	gt power: the power engine asks launchd whether the daemon job is loaded
internal/power/states.go	launchctl	pending-deletion	gt power: the power states bootout and bootstrap the launchd job
internal/templates/supervisor_state.go	launchctl	pending-deletion	remaining launchd references: the supervisor state reads the launchd job and its repair command
internal/templates/templates.go	launchctl	pending-deletion	remaining launchd references: the plist loader unloads and loads the launchd job
internal/testpolicy/cmd/testtiming/main.go	launchctl	pending-deletion	remaining launchd references: the test-timing tool starts its tmux server through launchctl submit
internal/testutil/unittier/tools.go	diskutil	pending-deletion	lsof and diskutil reads: the unit tier tool list names diskutil, which the disk-space read runs
internal/testutil/unittier/tools.go	launchctl	pending-deletion	remaining launchd references: the unit tier tool list names launchctl, which the launchd references run
internal/util/diskspace_darwin.go	diskutil	pending-deletion	lsof and diskutil reads: the disk-space read runs diskutil info
